uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

3693-4613-8335.description:
Activate Neelix by using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Neelix triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2105-6965-7431-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-6965-7431-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-6965-7431-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Daydream from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Daydream from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

3755-4824-7008.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3629-7074-8089.easyPrerequisites: Cloudsteel Kirin attached to a creature you control.
3629-7074-8089.description:
Activate Koh by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

648-1880-6012--147.manaNeeded: {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the kicker spell kicked
648-1880-6012--147.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to leave the battlefield.
648-1880-6012--147.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Cause the Fractal to leave the battlefield.
Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters onto Hallar equal to the number the Fractal had.
Cast any kicker or multikicker spell with kicker by paying its mana cost plus its kicker cost.
Hallar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself, then dealing damage equal to the number of +1/+1 counters on it to each opponent.

5315-5777-7810.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
5315-5777-7810.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability
Repeat.

2232-7827-7830-7835.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7830-7835.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

359-372-2781.manaNeeded: {6}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
359-372-2781.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Felidar Guardian to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Felidar Guardian's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3010-3259-7060.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3010-3259-7060.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Moonblade Shinobi, triggering Breath of Fury and Moonblade Shinobi.
Resolve the Moonblade Shinobi trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1987-2187-2427.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
1987-2187-2427.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Possessed Skaab.
When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2187-2427.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

129-1115-1409-3755.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1619-2292-4605-5542-6153.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2292-4605-5542-6153.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Vicious Battlerager from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Vicious Battlerager enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Vicious Battlerager.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Vicious Battlerager that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Vicious Battlerager token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Vicious Battlerager token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Vicious Battlerager that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Vicious Battlerager trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2292-4605-5542-6153.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

725-1432-4747.notablePrerequisites:
You control another legendary creature.
You had a creature with power 2 or greater enter the battlefield this turn.
725-1432-4747.description:
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Alena and another legendary creature.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping the other legendary creature, untapping Ioreth.
Repeat.

2104-4863-7631.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Revolutionist
When the Revolutionist token enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4798-6462-7178.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
4798-6462-7178.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers. Holding priority, activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Resolve the Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-2638-4693.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-2638-4693.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Tireless Tracker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

141-6797-6816.description:
Cast Infuse with Vitality by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Infuse with Vitality, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Infuse with Vitality.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Phantom Train abilities from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

522-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Melira.
When Melira dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1987-3227-4276-4823.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-3227-4276-4823.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Scrivener and Timeless Witness.
When Scrivener and Timeless Witness enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3227-4276-4823.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

147-2438-6928.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2438-6928.description:
Cast Prison Break either from your hand by paying {4}{B} or from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {3}{B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Prison Break.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Prison Break, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Prison Break copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2438-6928.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if Prison Break is in your graveyard.

1409-2034-2054-3895.description:
Activate Diregraf Horde by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Diregraf Horde enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Diregraf Horde.
Resolve the Diregraf Horde trigger, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Zombies, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Urn of Godfire by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

1399-1606-1680-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two permanent cards in your graveyard.
1399-1606-1680-6071.description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and The Core.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

560-1563-2457-4927.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

4067-5745.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that you don't own.
4067-5745.description:
Activate Staff of Eden by tapping it, causing you to draw at least one card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Staff of Eden.
Repeat.
4067-5745.notes: This combo can net more cards drawn per loop if you control multiple permanents that you don't own.

3484-3921-5391-6753.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
3484-3921-5391-6753.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1786-3591-6282.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one more card in hand than your maximum hand size.
1786-3591-6282.description:
Proceed to your cleanup step, causing you to discard cards down to your maximum hand size.
Necropotence triggers for each card discarded.
Resolve the first trigger, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Discard cards down until your maximum hand size, as the cleanup step is still onging.
Repeat from step 2.

618-4142-5686.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Hostage Taker.
When the Hostage Taker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Hostage Taker token.
When the Hostage Taker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1115-3372-5231-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
1115-3372-5231-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {R}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

64-1799-2579-2701-4050.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Warden of the Eye, adding one mana of any color.
When Warden of the Eye dies, The Cauldron of Eternity triggers, putting Warden of the Eye from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Warden of the Eye from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Warden of the Eye enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Grenzo's ability any number of times.

204-1387-3881-3923.notablePrerequisites:
Blistercoil Weird does not have summoning sickness.
Sorcerer Class is at least level two.
204-1387-3881-3923.description:
Activate Blistercoil Weird by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Cast Mystic Speculaiton with buyback by paying {U}.
Blistercoil Weird triggers, and Sorcerer Class's third ability triggers if it it level three.
Resolve the Blistercoil Weird trigger, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping it.
Resolve the Sorcerer Class trigger, if applicable, dealing damage to each opponent equal to the number of instants and sorceries you've cast this turn.
Resolve Mystic Speculation, causing you to scry 3 and return Mystic Speculation to your hand.
Repeat.

1322-3942-3982-4872.notablePrerequisites:
If Living Lore is in your graveyard, you have not played a creature spell using Karador this turn.
An opponent is unable to block your creatures.
1322-3942-3982-4872.description:
Cast Living Lore from your hand or graveyard by paying {3}{U}.
Living Lore enters the battlefield, exiling Time Warp from your graveyard.
Move to your combat phase, and deal combat damage with Living Lore.
Living Lore triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and cast Time Warp from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Time Warp, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

969-1312-3770-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gixian Puppeteer, adding {B}.
When Gixian Puppeteer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Doomed Necromancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Doomed Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping and sacrificing it, returning Gixian Puppeteer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

248-380-1430.description:
Cast Changeling Berserker by paying {3}{R}.
Changeling Berserker enters the battlefield, triggering its champion ability and Miirym.
Resolve the Changeling Berserker trigger, championing Mirror Image.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a copy of Changeling Berserker.
The token Changeling Berserker enters the battlefield, championing the nontoken Changeling Berserker.
The nontoken Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, returning Mirror Image from exile to the battlefield as a copy of the Changeling Berserker token.
Mirror Image enters the battlefield, triggering its champion ability and Miirym.
Resolve the Mirror Image trigger, championing the token Changeling Berserker.
The token Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Changeling Berserker from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all remaining Miirym triggers, creating infinite nonlegendary copies of Mirror Image that can copy any creatures you control.

1283-2011-2034.notablePrerequisites:
Najeela does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two other Warriors that can attack this turn.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
1283-2011-2034.description:
Declare Najeela and at least two other Warriors as attackers.
Najeela triggers at least three times, creating at least three 1/1 Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three Warriors, adding {6}.
Activate Najeela by paying {5}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1806-2034-2565.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Nightmare Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Nightmare Shepherd trigger, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard and creating a 1/1 copy of Eternal Scourge that is a Nightmare in addition to its other types.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eternal Scourge token, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.
